item.title: Man gets prison for robbing Lubbock gas station with machete
item.description: After taking an open plea, Matthew Martinez, 32, was sentenced by a judge on Tuesday to 50 years in prison for robbing a Lubbock gas station with a machete in 2024.

item.title: Guilty plea in Lubbock deadly crash leads to 16-month jail term
item.description: Charles Flacy pleaded guilty to Negligent Homicide and will spend 16 months in the State Jail for a deadly crash that occurred in December 2019, which resulted in the death of Zatryx Boggus and serious injuries to Carolyne Travis.

item.title: Austin police release body-cam footage, 911 calls from Sixth Street mass shooting
item.description: Austin Police released new information and video about the deadly mass shooting at a bar on West Sixth Street during a news conference Thursday.
